scope: Saved full-JLC-R aggregate counters only; no new simulation or causal attribution.
aggregation: Per 14-day 100-node run; equal means over 12 paired seeds and 8 weather-supply cells.

interpretation.guard_ready_requests: Member requests at protected CHs where a reference upstream cache is ready; events, not distinct packets.
interpretation.guard_additional_slot_only_denials: Member requests rejected by the triggered extra slot threshold when the original guard and energy checks passed.
interpretation.recovery_attempts: Extra candidate actions attempted by the bounded recovery loop.
interpretation.recovery_successful_hops: Recovery actions that succeeded at the next hop, which may or may not be the sink.
interpretation.held_packet_actions: Actions involving an already held packet; not a count of priority-induced changes or saved packets.

unavailable_from_aggregate_records: final delivery and freshness of packets affected by individual Guard or recovery events
counterfactual outcome of each denied request
the number of actions changed specifically by committed-first priority
per-action bottleneck CH battery, credit and Guard balances
